About Me

THE

BEHIND
THE CODE

I'm a performance-driven Full Stack Software Engineer with a deep passion for building resilient, high-capacity systems. My engineering philosophy is rooted in defensive programming and secure-by-design principles — security and integrity aren't afterthoughts, they're foundations.

Trained at Alupe University (BSc. Computer Science) and Moringa School, I specialize in Go, Rust, Python, and TypeScript. But I'm more than an engineer — I'm a filmmaker, photographer, and visual storyteller who bridges the gap between complex logic and human-centered design.
